## Introduction

This guide serves as a comprehensive manual for integrating with the game server through HTTP RESTful API. By following this guide, partners can establish communication with the server. Once the APIs are successfully integrated, partners can develop their own back-office systems and engage in gameplay.

**Flow Diagram**

```
Client HTML5           Game Server            Partner Server
    |                      |                       |
    |--- Launch URL ------->|                       |
    |   (pid, gid, atk)     |--- Auth Request ----->|
    |                       |                       |--- Check Token
    |                       |<-- Auth Response -----|
    |<-- Login Session ------|                       |
    |--- Play Request ------>|                       |
    |                       |--- Bet Result -------->|
    |                       |<-- Balance ------------|
    |                       |--- Win Result -------->|
    |                       |<-- Balance ------------|
    |<-- Play Result --------|                       |
```

---

## H5 Game Launch URL

```
https://${h5server}/?pid=PlayerID&gid=GameID&atk=AuthToken&lang=en&url=URL
```

| Parameter | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `gid` | Unique game identifier (GameID). |
| `pid` | Player ID in format `partner_code-partner_player_id`. Only one `-` is acceptable. |
| `atk` | Authentication token generated by the partner platform server. |
| `lang` | Language code (e.g., `en` for English). |
| `url` | Redirect URL when player exits the game. |
| `sdt` | Number display format: 0=Default (1000.00), 1=Comma (1,000.00), 2=Period (1.000,00), 3=Space (1 000.00), 4=Apostrophe (1'000.00). |

---

## API Security

### JWT with HS256

All requests use a shared secret key (HS256) between the partner platform server and the game server. The JWT token must be placed in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header.

**Claims must be generated from the full request payload.**

```go
// Example: Generate JWT Token
func generateJWTTokenV2(payload map[string]interface{}, secret string) (string, error) {
    claims := golang_jwt.MapClaims{}
    for key, value := range payload {
        claims[key] = value
    }
    token := golang_jwt.NewWithClaims(golang_jwt.SigningMethodHS256, claims)
    jwtSecret := []byte(secret)
    return token.SignedString(jwtSecret)
}
```

```go
// Example: Request with JWT
func RequestApi(url string, body []byte, token string) {
    resp, err := resty.New().
        SetBody(body).
        SetHeader("Content-Type", "application/json").
        SetHeader("Authorization", "Bearer "+token).
        Post(url)
}
```

## Integration Steps

### API Integration

#### Create Account API

> **Only for Wallet transfer mode.**

Creates a player account on the game server before any balance updates.

**API URL:** `POST https://${gameserver}/nv/create-account`

**Request:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `PlayerID` | string | Yes | Unique player identifier in format `partner_code-partner_player_id`. Only one `-` is acceptable. |

```json
{ "PlayerID": "partner_code-partner_player_id" }
```

**Response:**

```json
{ "Payload": "{ \"TransactionID\": \"473178637709869057\" }" }
```

---

### API Hook Integration

The partner platform server must implement the following hooks. **All hooks are called with a JWT Authorization header that must be validated.**

#### Authentication API Hook

Validates the player's AuthToken, PlayerID, and GameID when the player attempts to access the game server.

**Hook URL:** `POST https://${your.server.domain}/auth-check`

**Request:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `AuthToken` | string | Yes | Authentication token generated by the partner platform server (from the `atk` URL parameter). |
| `PlayerID` | string | Yes | Player ID in format `partner_code-partner_player_id`. |
| `GameID` | string | Yes | Game identifier (from the `gid` URL parameter). |

```json
{
  "AuthToken": "WEQsqwGFDVSdfwEWds",
  "PlayerID": "partner_code-partner_player_id",
  "GameID": "03E9"
}
```

**Response:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `GameID` | string | Yes | The game identifier. |
| `IsWalletIntegrated` | boolean | Yes | `true` = wallet transfer mode; `false` = seamless mode. |
| `Balance` | int | No | Player balance × 100 (for DecimalPlace=2). Not mandatory for wallet transfer mode. |
| `CoinsMap` | array int | No | Coin selection settings. Not mandatory if Create Account integration applied. |
| `CoinValueMap` | array int | No | Coin value settings. Not mandatory if Create Account integration applied. |
| `DefaultCoins` | int | No | Default coin setting. Not mandatory if Create Account integration applied. |
| `DefaultCoinValue` | int | No | Default coin value setting. Not mandatory if Create Account integration applied. |
| `EnableFreeRounds` | boolean | No | Enable free rounds. |
| `AwardFreeRounds` | int | No | Number of free rounds awarded. |
| `FreeRoundCoins` | int | No | Coin bet setting for free rounds. |
| `FreeRoundCoinValue` | int | No | Coin value bet for free rounds. |
| `DecimalPlace` | int | No | Decimal position (0–2). If 2, balance 10000 = 100.00. Not mandatory if Create Account applied. |

```json
{
  "GameID": "03EA",
  "IsWalletIntegrated": false
}
```

---

### Play Result APIs (Seamless mode only)

#### Bet Result API Hook

Called when a player places a bet. Deducts the `BetAmount` from the player's balance.

**Hook URL:** `POST https://${your.server.domain}/bet-result`

**Request:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `SpinID` | string | Yes | Unique spin identifier within the round. |
| `RoundID` | string | Yes | Unique round identifier. |
| `PlayerID` | string | Yes | Player ID. |
| `GameID` | string | Yes | Game identifier. |
| `BetAmount` | int | Yes | Bet amount × 100 (e.g., 100.00 = 10000). |

```json
{
  "SpinID": "473178637708820028",
  "RoundID": "RD1234",
  "PlayerID": "partner_code-partner_player_id",
  "GameID": "07D1",
  "BetAmount": 1000
}
```

**Response:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `Balance` | int | Yes | Player balance after the spin × 100. |

```json
{ "Balance": 11000 }
```

**Error Cases:**

- Normal error (HTTP 500): `{ "code": 13, "message": "Internal Server Error" }`
- Definitely insufficient balance (balance ≤ 0 or balance < min bet): `{ "code": 17, "message": "Not Enough Balance" }`
- Partially insufficient (balance < current bet, but can bet lower): `{ "Balance": 100, "code": 17, "message": "Not Enough Balance" }`

---

#### Win Result API Hook

Called after a spin completes to credit the player's winnings.

**Hook URL:** `POST https://${your.server.domain}/win-result`

**Request:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `SpinID` | string | Yes | Unique spin identifier. |
| `RoundID` | string | Yes | Unique round identifier. |
| `PlayerID` | string | Yes | Player ID. |
| `GameID` | string | Yes | Game identifier. |
| `IsRoundEnd` | boolean | Yes | Whether this is the last spin in the round. |
| `WinAmount` | int | Yes | Win amount × 100. `0` means player lost. |

```json
{
  "SpinID": "473178637708820028",
  "RoundID": "RD1234",
  "PlayerID": "partner_code-partner_player_id",
  "GameID": "07D1",
  "IsRoundEnd": false,
  "WinAmount": 1000
}
```

**Response:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `Balance` | int | Yes | Player balance after the spin × 100. |

```json
{ "Balance": 11000 }
```

---

#### Cancel Result API Hook

Called to rollback a bet when `/bet-result` repeatedly fails, or when `/win-result` with FreeSpin/AwardFreeSpins encounters an error.

**Hook URL:** `POST https://${your.server.domain}/cancel-result`

**Request:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `SpinID` | string | Yes | Unique spin identifier. |
| `RoundID` | string | Yes | Unique round identifier. |
| `PlayerID` | string | Yes | Player ID. |
| `GameID` | string | Yes | Game identifier. |

```json
{
  "SpinID": "473178637708820028",
  "RoundID": "RD1234",
  "PlayerID": "partner_code-partner_player_id",
  "GameID": "07D1"
}
```

**Response:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `Balance` | int | Yes | Player balance after cancellation × 100. |

```json
{ "Balance": 11000 }
```

### Player Wallet (Wallet transfer mode only)

Query or update a player's balance on the game server.

**API URL:** `POST https://${gameserver}/nv/player-wallet`

**Request:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `PartnerTransactionID` | string | Yes | Unique transaction ID in format `{yyyyMMddHHmmssfff}_{TransactionID}`. |
| `PlayerID` | string | Yes | Player ID. |
| `Action` | string | Yes | `"Query"`, `"Deposit"`, or `"Withdraw"`. |
| `Amount` | int | No | Amount × 100. Required for Deposit/Withdraw only. |

```json
{
  "PlayerID": "partner_code-partner_player_id",
  "PartnerTransactionID": "20230901123456789_rndm-tkn",
  "Action": "Deposit",
  "Amount": 100
}
```

**Response:**

| Key | Type | Description |
|-----|------|-------------|
| `PartnerTransactionID` | string | The transaction ID. |
| `Balance` | int | Player balance × 100. |

```json
{ "Payload": "{ \"PartnerTransactionID\": \"473178637709869057\", \"Balance\": 11000 }" }
```

---

### Check Wallet (Wallet transfer mode only)

Query a specific player transaction by `PartnerTransactionID`.

**API URL:** `POST https://${gameserver}/nv/check-wallet`

**Request:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `PartnerTransactionID` | string | Yes | Transaction ID to query. |
| `PlayerID` | string | Yes | Player ID. |

**Response:** Same structure as Player Wallet response.

---

### Player Records Report

#### Player Play History

**API URL:** `POST https://${gameserver}/nv/player-play-history`

**Request:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `PlayerID` | string | Yes | Player ID. |
| `GameID` | string | Yes | Game identifier. |
| `StartDate` | string | Yes | Start date (UTC+7), e.g., `"2023-01-01"`. |
| `EndDate` | string | Yes | End date (UTC+7), e.g., `"2023-01-31"`. |

**Response per record:**

| Key | Type | Description |
|-----|------|-------------|
| `SpinID` | string | Spin identifier. |
| `RoundID` | string | Round identifier. |
| `BetAmount` | int | Bet amount × 100. |
| `WinAmount` | int | Win amount × 100. |
| `IsFreeRounds` | boolean | Whether it was a free round. |
| `IsFreeSpins` | boolean | Whether it was a free spin. |
| `BalanceBefore` | int | Balance before spin × 100. |
| `BalanceAfter` | int | Balance after spin × 100. |

---

#### Player Wallet History (Wallet transfer mode only)

**API URL:** `POST https://${gameserver}/nv/player-wallet-history`

**Request:** `PlayerID`, `StartDate` (UTC+7, `"2006-01-02"`), `EndDate`.

**Response per record:** `PartnerTransactionID`, `Action`, `Amount` × 100, `Balance` × 100.

---

#### Play Detail

**API URL:** `POST https://${gameserver}/nv/play-detail`

**Request:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `PartnerCode` | string | Yes | Partner code. |
| `SpinID` | string | Yes | Spin ID. |

**Response fields:** `SpinID`, `RoundID`, `PlayerID`, `GameID`, `BetAmount`, `WinAmount`, `IsFreeRounds`, `IsFreeSpins`, `BalanceBefore`, `BalanceAfter`.

---

#### Round Detail

**API URL:** `POST https://${gameserver}/nv/round-detail`

**Request:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `PartnerCode` | string | Yes | Partner code. |
| `RoundID` | string | Yes | Round ID. |

**Response:** `RoundID`, `PlayerID`, `GameID`, `Results[]` (array of spins).

Each spin in `Results[]`: `SpinID`, `BetAmount`, `WinAmount`, `IsFreeRounds`, `IsFreeSpins`, `IsRoundEnd`, `BalanceBefore`, `BalanceAfter`, `GameStateGraphicalUrl`.

---

### Partner Records Report

#### Partner History

**API URL:** `POST https://${gameserver}/nv/partner-history`

**Request:** `PartnerCode`, `StartDate` (UTC+7, `"2006-01-02"`), `EndDate`.

**Response per game:** `GameID`, `BetAmount` × 100, `WinAmount` × 100, `RTP` (float).

---

#### Partner Detail

**API URL:** `POST https://${gameserver}/nv/partner-detail`
**V2 URL:** `POST https://${gameserver}/nv/v2/partner-detail`

**Request:** `PartnerCode`, `StartDate` (UTC+7, `"2006-01-02 15:04:05"`), `EndDate`.

**Response `Results[]`** (CSV-style array per spin): `PlayerID`, `GameID`, `SpinID`, `RoundID` (v2 only), `BetAmount`, `WinAmount`, `IsFreeRounds`, `IsFreeSpins`, `BalanceBefore`, `BalanceAfter`, `Time`.

---

### Game List

**API URL:** `POST https://${gameserver}/nv/games`

**Request:**

| Key | Type | Mandatory | Description |
|-----|------|-----------|-------------|
| `PartnerCode` | string | Yes | Partner code. |

**Response per game:** `GameID`, `GameName`.

```json
{
  "Results": [
    { "GameID": "03E9", "GameName": "Game A" },
    { "GameID": "07D1", "GameName": "Game B" }
  ]
}
```

---

### Wallet History for Players

**API URL:** `POST https://${gameserver}/nv/player-wallet-history`

**Request:** `PlayerID`, `StartDate` (UTC+7), `EndDate`.

**Response `Transactions[]`:** `PartnerTransactionID`, `Action`, `Amount` × 100, `Balance` × 100.

---

## Error Handling

| Error Type | Code | Description | HTTP Status |
|-----------|------|-------------|-------------|
| CANCELED | 1 | Request Timeout | 408 |
| UNKNOWN | 2 | Internal Server Error | 500 |
| INVALID_ARGUMENT | 3 | Bad Request | 400 |
| DEADLINE_EXCEEDED | 4 | Gateway Timeout | 504 |
| NOT_FOUND | 5 | Not Found | 404 |
| ALREADY_EXISTS | 6 | Conflict | 409 |
| PERMISSION_DENIED | 7 | Forbidden | 403 |
| RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED | 8 | Too Many Requests | 429 |
| FAILED_PRECONDITION | 9 | Bad Request | 400 |
| ABORTED | 10 | Conflict | 409 |
| OUT_OF_RANGE | 11 | Bad Request | 400 |
| UNIMPLEMENTED | 12 | Not Implemented | 501 |
| INTERNAL | 13 | Internal Server Error | 500 |
| UNAVAILABLE | 14 | Service Unavailable | 503 |
| DATA_LOSS | 15 | Internal Server Error | 500 |
| UNAUTHENTICATED | 16 | Unauthorized | 401 |
| BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT | 17 | Player not enough balance | 200 |
| DATA_PREPARING | 18 | Data is being prepared | 503 |
| PARTNER_CODE_NOT_FOUND | 19 | Partner not found | 401 |

**Error Response Format:**

```json
{ "code": "error code", "message": "error message" }
```
